title: Bachata Workshop for Beginners
description: Find your rhythm with the Dominican Student Association. Learn the basics of bachata in a relaxed, beginner-friendly workshop. No partner or experience needed.

title: Public Debate: Should Tuition Freeze?
description: Join an open conversation about the future of affordable education. Bring your perspective, listen to fellow students, & help shape the discussion.

title: Build Night: Line-Following Bots
description: Build a tiny robot with a big sense of direction. Work with a team to wire sensors & program a line-following bot. Materials provided; beginners welcome.

title: Friday Night Shabbat Dinner
description: Close out the week with a warm meal, good conversation, & community. All students are welcome at the table.

title: Saturday Scrimmage
description: Lace up & join a friendly afternoon on the field. Bring water & comfortable shoes. We will sort out teams when everyone arrives.

title: Golden Hour Photo Walk
description: Explore the campus in the soft evening light. Bring any camera, including your phone, & discover a new way to see familiar places.

title: Proofs & Pastries
description: Take a study break with a fresh pastry & a satisfying math puzzle. Collaborate on proofs with fellow students at every level.

title: Roblox Game Jam
description: Dream up a small game, team up with other creators, & bring your idea to life in Roblox Studio. Bring a laptop if you can.

title: Autumn Baking Social
description: Share seasonal treats, swap favorite recipes, & meet the Baking Club. A cozy afternoon for curious beginners & practiced bakers alike.

title: Campus Garden: Plant & Give
description: Plant herb seeds indoors & grow seedlings for spring distribution to neighborhood gardens.

title: An Evening Under the Stars
description: Look up with Starlight Astronomy. Try a telescope, learn to spot constellations, & share your biggest questions about the universe.

title: Stories Across Cultures
description: Bring a short passage from a book you love. We will read, listen, & explore the stories that connect our campus community.
